answer: At 31 December 2025, SLB KPI 1a reported 96% against a 100% renewable-energy objective and was not achieved; KPI 1b reported a published 5% reduction, with a comparable 10% reduction, against a 14% per-product cradle-to-shelf GHG-intensity reduction target and was not achieved; KPI 2 reported 50% recycled or biobased plastic packaging and was achieved. KPI 1a covers operated sites but excludes site safety and security equipment and applies specified Scope 1 exceptions and market-based Scope 2 criteria; KPI 1b excludes Aesop products; KPI 2 covers primary, secondary and tertiary packaging and rounds 50.14% down to 50%. The limited-assurance conclusion excludes earlier periods and information outside the ESG KPIs.

normalized_value.assurance_exclusion: earlier periods and information not included in the ESG KPIs

evidence.quote: This indicator covers primary, secondary and tertiary packaging.
The performance of 50.14% has been rounded down to 50%.
Our assurance does not extend to information in respect of earlier periods
